goal: Implement the approved sequence locally: preserve complete Tarot/Astrology answers and saved results, correct selected context, improve beginner journeys and representative library depth, add regression/evaluation fixtures and measured hybrid delivery preparation. Cloud activation, native acceptance and publishing follow their existing target gates.
successCriteria: Tarot sections survive render-save-reopen; old snapshots remain readable; local/AI states are explicit and retry preserves cards without a second local allowance event.
Astrology suggestions name the actual selected body/aspect; current selection facts survive the bounded, consented request; all answer sections, questions and caveats remain readable.
A bilingual representative learning slice and tappable sample questions guide beginners through one-card practice; navigation labels and destinations agree.
Mobile typecheck, meaningful regression tests, data checks, web export and Android embedded bundle are validated; build payload is measured and hybrid pilot readiness is explicit.

writeScopeRestrictions.apps/mobile/: Implement only Tarot/Astrology presentation, snapshot/context adapters, beginner flow, relevant labels and tests; preserve existing unrelated dirty work.
writeScopeRestrictions.packages/content/data/tarot-learning-dep: New versioned bilingual representative depth content; canonical card meanings and existing artwork unchanged.
writeScopeRestrictions.scripts/measure-mobile-content.mjs: Read-only payload measurement; no release or cloud writes.

untouchedSurfaces: Supabase cloud config, database, storage, RLS, migrations, credentials and target allowlist
Chart calculations, auth/payment business rules, canonical 78-card meanings and artwork

impact.entryPoint: Explore Tarot -> question/sample -> practice -> result -> Journal reopen; Astrology chart selection -> consented AI request -> full answer; reviewed Home/Profile links. Dev-only /__preview/tarot-depth harness renders the actual TarotFlow with synthetic sections and in-memory save/reopen; normal auth remains in App and production cannot enter this route.
impact.dataWrite: Add backward-compatible Tarot section/locale/version snapshots and preserve canonical reference meanings; existing Journal save/sync transports Record sourceSnapshot. No database schema changes. Prepare one offline Rose Mirror pilot ZIP and hash manifest inside task artifacts only; remote origin remains unset.
impact.backendContract: Keep existing Tarot sections transport and astrology AI invoke/response v1 schemas. Prioritize selected fact IDs within existing limit of 30 and privacy allowlist. No endpoint or credit-ledger changes.
impact.adminVisibility: No operator UI or raw user logs. Existing content/prompt tools remain; new representative educational content is a versioned local module. Evaluation and build measurements are sanitized owner evidence.
impact.privacySafety: No raw birth fields, Journal or history added to AI. Preserve consent, account scope, Premium gates, moderation and symbolic reflection framing; sanitized synthetic tests only.
impact.observability: Existing metadata-only usage events retained; retry is a distinct event and never a second tarot_reading_drawn event. Record source/bundle/test evidence separately from native and live AI.
impact.rollback: Revert only this task diff; optional snapshot fields tolerate old entries. Default deck and core Astrology remain bundled until a separately validated remote pack is enabled.
impact.surfacesIntentionallyUntouched: No cloud project retarget, credentials, migrations, deployment, prompt/model publication, payments, chart calculations or art changes.
impact.agentHandoff: Root owns edits and validation. No delegation required; independent full-deck bilingual review is out of this representative slice.

canonicalContracts: apps/mobile/src/types.ts defines Tarot local snapshots; existing backendClient TarotInterpretationResult defines sections transport.
packages/agent-config/astrology-ai-insight/contract.json and its invocation/response schemas remain canonical; no new transport fields.
packages/content/data/tarot-cards.json remains canonical 78-card meanings; tarot-learning-depth.json adds reviewed representative teaching prose.

skillReview.name: nilaza-plan-qc
skillReview.evidence: Read repository SKILL.md, expanded cross-app reference, protocol and current validator. Apply impact, preflight, dirty-state preservation, synthetic QA and evidence separation; no durable skill change is required for this audit.

skillReview.name: nilaza-brand-experience
skillReview.evidence: Read repository SKILL.md and routed Open Reflection guidelines, design and rollout status. Audit retains approved branding and separates design intention from verified browser or native behavior; no brand assets or public content are changed.

skillReview.name: nilaza-tarot-content-qc
skillReview.evidence: Representative educational copy is bilingual and linked to canonical meanings; preserve artwork-specific claims for cards with observed source artwork. No full-deck regeneration or new deck acceptance.

skillReview.name: nilaza-tarot-deck-production
skillReview.evidence: Reviewed scope: educational module only, not new deck, canonical deck copy, artwork or scene update. Preserve deck/card assets and their existing QC; no new production deck gate invoked.

dependencyReview.evidence: Changes use existing source contracts and installed APIs; no new packages or externally recommended versions. Source-local adapters and tests do not change calculation or provider APIs.

securityReview.authzRls: No authorization or RLS changes; preserve account scope and current protected request guards. Tests mock provider boundaries. The added QA route must be inside __DEV__, never use an account, never fetch or persist private records, and provide a visible synthetic-data label.
securityReview.sensitiveData: Facts-only Astrology allowlist and current question only. No new history, Journal, birth, location or identifiers sent; source snapshots retain normal private Journal handling.
securityReview.secretsLogging: Do not read .env files or print process secrets. Set process-local EXPO_NO_DOTENV=1, clear EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL, EXPO_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY and EXPO_PUBLIC_NILAZA_API_URL, clear Admin URL and disable trace capture.
securityReview.externalInput: Validate optional Tarot sections before reading them; never let arbitrary output add cards or override orientations. Selected Astro fact IDs must exist in calculated chart.
securityReview.dependencies: No dependency upgrades. Use existing Expo 54 / RN 0.81 / Jest versions and existing APIs. No volatile API claims.
securityReview.migrationRelease: No database writes, migrations, runtime retargeting, target activation, credential use, build distribution, deployment or publishing. Existing backend and release gates remain intact.
securityReview.stopCondition: Local dev preview clears dotenv/cloud endpoints; do not use production credentials or publish. Stop if real private records appear, scope cannot be isolated, or exact cloud target approval is required.

workingTreeReview.note: Existing broad mobile dirty state and shared source hashes from the prior audit are preserved; edits apply to reviewed current bytes. No checkout/reset/cleanup of pre-existing work. Implementation and task-owned test/build artifacts inventoried after validation; previous dirty work preserved. Final source, 8 screenshots, browser observations, evidence, final builds, pilot archive and evaluation scenarios inventoried. Only task-owned preview services were stopped.

validationCommands: Synthetic browser walkthrough VI/EN and native manager test separately
managerTestPath: Explore -> Tarot -> select sample question -> one card -> summary -> full sections -> save -> Journal -> reopen unchanged. Astrology fixture -> Sun -> Venus -> aspect -> consented guide question -> full sections and per-section evidence. Offline/error/retry must preserve the same Tarot cards and local allowance count; VI/EN, narrow screen and large text.
residualRisk: Live provider quality, independently reviewed full-deck expansion, actual newcomer testing, native device acceptance and cloud hybrid target activation require their own evidence; local delivery does not certify those gates.
note: A gate attempt flagged four new task-owned Jest cache files before QA harness edits. The intended scope was already authorized; the cache inventory and dev-only source were refreshed and the gate is rerun before further commands. This was a sequencing error, not a high-risk approval bypass.
